user.title: Connect to Social Schools
user.description: Sign in with the Social Schools account of a parent. The password is only used to obtain a token and is not stored.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to Social Schools.
data_description.password: The password of your Social Schools account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Social Schools again
reauth_confirm.description: The Social Schools login of {username} is no longer valid. Enter the password to sign in again.

data_description.password: The current password of your Social Schools account.

error.unsupported: The Social Schools login page is not supported by this version of the integration
error.no_parent_role: This account has no parent role at any school

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The credentials belong to a different account than the one being re-authenticated

data_description.posts_interval: How often Home Assistant checks Social Schools for new posts, in minutes.
data_description.calendar_days: Number of days ahead for which calendar events are fetched.
data_description.posts_in_list: Number of posts kept in the list attribute of the posts sensor.
data_description.lezers: Persons who must have read a post before it is no longer new. Read marks stay in Home Assistant and are never sent to Social Schools.
data_description.kinderen: Children and their groups come from the Social Schools account and are refreshed daily. Add a line such as Noud=6A only to add a child or to replace the groups of a child. Separate several groups with a comma. Group names must match exactly; case is ignored.

error.invalid_children: Every line must look like Name=group, group

no_parent_role.message: The Social Schools account has no parent role at any school

not_a_reader.message: {person} is not one of the readers of this integration

unknown_post.message: Post {post_id} is not in the current feed

open_failed.message: Post {post_id} could not be opened; the previous post is still shown

markeer_gelezen.name: Mark as read
markeer_gelezen.description: Marks a post as read (or unread) by a person. This stays in Home Assistant; nothing is sent to Social Schools.

post_id.name: Post ID
post_id.description: The ID of a post in the current feed.

persoon.name: Person
persoon.description: Who read the post. Leave empty to use the person of the user who calls the action.

gelezen.name: Read
gelezen.description: Turn off to remove the read mark again.

markeer_alles_gelezen.name: Mark all as read
markeer_alles_gelezen.description: Marks every post in the feed as read by a person. This stays in Home Assistant.

persoon.name: Person
persoon.description: Who read the posts. Leave empty to use the person of the user who calls the action.

open_bericht.name: Open post
open_bericht.description: Shows the full text of a post in the opened post sensor: straight from the feed, or fetched once for a post that has dropped out of the feed since. Opening marks nothing as read.

post_id.name: Post ID
post_id.description: The ID of a post in the feed, or of one that has dropped out of it since.
